title: Drunk Basket
seo_title: Drunk Basket — Play Free 2 Player Basketball Game Online
meta_desc: Play Drunk Basket free online. Wobbly ragdoll basketball for 1-2 players — charge shots, sink baskets and outscore your friend on one keyboard.
desc: Drunk Basket is ragdoll basketball at its wobbliest. Physics-driven players lurch, lean and launch shots; charge the right amount and sink baskets solo or against a friend on the same keyboard.
howto: Player 1 holds W to charge a shot and releases to throw.
Player 2 holds the Up Arrow to charge and releases to throw.
Time the charge — overcooked shots sail long.
Play solo against the AI or head-to-head.
Sink more baskets than your rival.
tips: Learn one charge level that hits consistently.
Watch the lean of your player — it telegraphs the arc.
Shoot first after every make to steal the rhythm.
